author: official
summary: Displays a site or guild catalog with instant per-item Buy checkout for Square sellers only.

attributes.name: data-dynamic-coral
attributes.description: Selects the square-shop coral.

attributes.name: data-site-id
attributes.description: Site locator; use this or data-guild-id.

attributes.name: data-guild-id
attributes.description: Guild locator; takes precedence over data-site-id.

attributes.name: data-api-base
attributes.description: Backend origin; empty means same origin. Deployment builds may stamp a different default.

attributes.name: data-locale
attributes.description: Preferred locale for shop copy; falls back to data-shop-locale, page lang, then en-US.

attributes.name: data-cart
attributes.description: Set to 1 for cart mode, or header for cart mode without the sidebar. Other values use instant per-item Buy.

attributes.name: data-collect-shipping
attributes.description: Set to 1 to request shipping details in cart mode only.

attributes.name: data-detail-base
attributes.description: Base URL for product detail links.

attributes.name: data-shop-locale
attributes.description: Fallback locale for shop copy when data-locale is absent; then page lang or en-US.

attributes.name: data-buy-label
attributes.description: Buy button override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-add-label
attributes.description: Add-to-cart button override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-choose-options-label
attributes.description: Options prompt override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-checkout-label
attributes.description: Checkout button override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-subtotal-label
attributes.description: Prefix for the JPY total row only; unused for other currencies. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-cart-heading
attributes.description: Cart heading override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-empty-cart-label
attributes.description: Empty cart override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-sold-out-label
attributes.description: Sold-out badge override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-view-cart-label
attributes.description: View cart link override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-in-cart-label
attributes.description: Already-in-cart label override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-shop-label
attributes.description: Shop label override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-confirm-price-label
attributes.description: Price confirmation override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-remove-label
attributes.description: Remove button override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-quantity-label
attributes.description: Quantity override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-sold-out-message
attributes.description: Sold-out message override. Localized label (default per locale).

attributes.name: data-price-changed-message
